title: Juicy Kenyan Tomato Stir-fry
description: This festive dish features fresh, juicy tomatoes in a savory sauce with shaoxing wine for a low-calorie-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onions and sauté until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant.
Slice tomatoes into wedges and add to the pan. Cook for 5-7 minutes until softened but not mushy.
Pour in shaoxing wine and let it reduce by half, about 3 minutes.
Stir in soy sauce, salt, and pepper. Simmer for an additional 2-3 minutes until thickened slightly.
Garnish with fresh herbs (optional) before serving.
